system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the hofund codebase. This Java/Spring library exposes application, connection, graph, and git metadata via Micrometer/Prometheus and includes datasource and HTTP connection checks. Identify subtle bugs, security regressions, data consistency issues, and logic flaws. Focus on issues detectable via static analysis. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md.

rubric.criterion: Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/AbstractHofundBasicHttpConnection.java (testConnection) that HTTP success is limited to 2xx only, causing 3xx redirect responses to be treated as DOWN

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/AbstractHofundBasicHttpConnection.java (testConnection) that read timeout is set using the connect timeout value instead of the read timeout

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionResult.java (extractVersionFromResponse) that version extraction uses the first "version" key without anchoring to the "application" object

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnection.java (getEnvVarName) that hyphens in target names are removed rather than converted to underscores when building env var names
Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/graph/node/HofundNodeMeter.java (checkIdCollision) that ID collision checking iterates connections in parallel over a non-thread-safe list

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionMeter.java (bindTo) that the gauge is registered with a constant precomputed status value instead of querying live connection status
Identifies in hofund-spring/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/spring/datasource/DataSourceConnectionFactory.java (of) that the datasource metadata connection is not closed after use

Identifies in hofund-spring/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/spring/datasource/DatasourceConnection.java (testConnection) that query timeout is multiplied by 1000, treating seconds as milliseconds and vastly increasing timeout
